notes.why_A7118436590B_was_superseded: Its hashed operations embedded per_campaign_limits.september_campaign_maximum of 142.76 (Gas Boiler) and 426.32 (HVAC Replacement), computed by the retracted method 'September spend + highest budget in force on the edit day + new daily x remaining days after the edit day'. The corrected figures are 105.00 and 420.00. Because the retracted assertion sat inside a hashed plan field and was a mandatory precondition, the fingerprint was superseded rather than executed.

retracted_combined_figure.why: The prior method also applied spend-to-date plus one budget per remaining day to the three UNCHANGED campaigns. A campaign with no September budget edit carries its own applicable monthly charging limit instead.

current_month_september.cost_basis: SERVED cost. Google Ads exposes no per-month BILLED figure through this API surface without monthly invoicing. Served cost can still be restated by invalid-activity credits.
